subject: Sigillaria single ribbed lycopsid column
factual_scope: Genus-level single unbranched Rhytidolepis-type ribbed reconstruction, not an asserted exact species specimen. Seward original museum illustrations support leaf-scar morphology; DiMichele2013 primary discussion supports little or no dichotomized crown in Sigillaria. Crown dimensions, selected scar/rib count and six-metre scene scale artistic.
identifying_features: One continuous unjointed tapering column with twelve broad uninterrupted vertical ribs, each bearing sixteen vertically spaced broad shallow polygonal leaf scars. No diagonal Lepidodendron diamond cushion lattice.
Select one unbranched Rhytidolepis-type genus-level habit: no dichotomous crown or woody lateral branches. Dome-like apex bears42 long simple tapered strap microphylls, not compound palm fronds.
Four short subdued outward rhizomorph beginnings at the base, not a taproot or complete subterranean root claim. Sterile reconstruction with no cones.
